acceptanceCriteria.summary: Build 3's listener requirement is proven, while the macOS build 4 target and exported executable contain no local-remote listener path.
The exported distribution-signed app has only sandbox and user-selected file access capabilities and no network entitlements or local-network plist keys.
The submitted reviewer reply and saved review notes truthfully identify the build 4 removal, while the five Store screenshots do not claim the deferred Remote feature.
31 tests, universal Mac Release/archive/export, and the iPhone plus embedded Watch Release build pass; the exported app is signed, universal, and versioned 1.0 (4).
Build 4 was uploaded, selected, and resubmitted after approval; fresh Store readback shows Waiting for Review, while approval, public release, and mobile Store actions remain unclaimed.
